steps.maps_to: C# has no equivalent split: Creature.PrepareForNextTurn -> MonsterModel.RollMove advances EVERY monster's machine, and a monster with one looping move simply re-rolls to the same state (its FollowUpState is itself, e.g. Architect.cs:21, BigDummy.cs:25).
steps.rationale: Same observable move sequence and same draw count. Executed: `grep -rn 'def telegraph_next_move' sts2_rl/` returns 9 definitions — the base no-op, MachineMonster's override (state_machine.py:326) which every machine monster inherits, and 7 hand-rolled overrides (flyconid.py:71, fuzzy_wurm_crawler.py:53, inklets.py:56, shrinker_beetle.py:47, slimes.py:47 and :137, slithering_strangler.py:51). The monsters that inherit the no-op are the fixed-single-move ones, for which C#'s re-roll is a self-transition that draws nothing (a MoveState whose FollowUpState is itself: MoveState.GetNextState is deterministic, step 10). The base no-op is a footgun, not a divergence, and the only way it becomes one is a new hand-rolled monster with a branch and no override — which is what test/test_monster_branch_audit.py's zero-draw assertions guard.

guards.what: N6 — KinPriest.AfterDeath, handed to this record by hook_dispatch as 'Task 10's content finding'
guards.rationale: Presentation — and this OVERTURNS hook_dispatch's framing of it as a contended content gap. hook_dispatch's scope note says KinPriest.cs:81-108's all-followers-dead AllFollowerDeathResponse has no counterpart in the ported sim KinPriest (monsters/overgrowth/the_kin.py:67-110). Read to the end, AllFollowerDeathResponse is `TalkCmd.Play(_followersDeathLine, Creature, VfxColor.Purple, VfxDuration.Standard)` and nothing else (KinPriest.cs:197-200) — a barks line with a colour and a duration — and the other arm of the same override is NRunMusicController.UpdateMusicParameter('the_kin_progress', ...) (KinPriest.cs:95, 106), a music parameter. The ENTIRE override is presentation, so there is no mechanical behaviour for the sim's KinPriest to be missing and the correct verdict is waiver, not a dormant gap. hook_dispatch's own verdict — that the sim has no MonsterModel listener category to hang a monster hook on (its G5, dormant) — is unaffected and is not re-verdicted here.
